name: voiceapp-api
description: Voice App credits / devices / setup API

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U voiceapp -d voiceapp
scripts.db:tables: docker compose exec postgres psql -U voiceapp -d voiceapp -c '\dt'
scripts.db:stats: docker compose exec postgres psql -U voiceapp -d voiceapp -c "SELECT * FROM voiceapp_stats; SELECT key, value FROM voiceapp_setup WHERE key = 'free_credits_install_cap';"
scripts.db:devices: docker compose exec postgres psql -U voiceapp -d voiceapp -c 'SELECT device_id, plan, credits, free_credits, free_credits_expires_at, installed_at, plan_enabled_at, plan_disabled_at FROM voiceapp_devices ORDER BY installed_at DESC LIMIT 20;'
